claim_text: Yield stress is strongly orientation dependent and, in [11-20] and [01-10], reaches ~145-165 MPa at RT, about 11x the pure-Mg single crystal

steps.observation: RT yield stress by orientation: ~9 MPa for [1 1 -2 1.85], ~148-165 MPa for [11-20], ~143 MPa for [01-10]; [0001] fractures at ~355 MPa without yielding
steps.image_note: the linked text quotes ~130 MPa for [11-20] at RT, but the plotted RT points are ~148 and ~165 MPa; the [0001] points are labelled 'fracture' on the panel

panels.caption_span: Temperature dependence of the yield stress of the as-grown Mg99.2Zn0.20.6 single crystal in four loading orientations. The yield stress of the pure-Mg single crystals reported in ref. [32] and that measured in this study are also plotted in gray for comparison

steps.observation: Between RT and 400 C the alloy's [11-20]/[01-10] yield stress falls only from ~165 to ~105 MPa, while the gray pure-Mg reference falls from ~270 to ~15 MPa and sits near 10 MPa in the soft orientations
steps.image_note: 'gray plots: pure-Mg' is written on the panel, but the gray symbols are not individually labelled by orientation, so the ~11x factor rests on reading the gray circle near 10-12 MPa at RT

panels.caption_span: Temperature dependence of the yield stress of the as-grown Mg99.2Zn0.20.6 single crystal in four loading orientations. The yield stress of the pure-Mg single crystals reported in ref. [32] and that measured in this study are also plotted in gray for comparison

steps.observation: Yield stress in [11-20] at RT: 167 MPa as-grown, 113 MPa after the 520 C anneal, 160 MPa after the further 400 C anneal
steps.image_note: bar chart, three states, one bar each, no scatter shown; the drop and recovery track the nanoplate density of Fig. 1(f)

panels.caption_span: Variation in the yield stress with heat treatment for deformation in the [1120] orientation at RT
